let StartTime=_startTime;
let EndTime=_endTime;
let UserFilter=tostring(_user);
let HostFilter=tostring(_host);
let SessionFilter=tostring(_session);
let ConfigurationCategoryFilter=tostring(_configurationCategory);
let ConfigLatest=materialize(CitrixSession_SessionConfig
| where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
| extend User=tolower(SessionUser),SessionKey=tostring(SessionGUID)
| where isempty(UserFilter) or User =~ UserFilter
| where isempty(HostFilter) or Host =~ HostFilter
| where isempty(SessionFilter) or SessionKey == SessionFilter
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp,*) by SessionKey);
let Settings=union
(ConfigLatest | project SessionKey,User,Host,Category="Graphics",Setting="Display mode",Value=iff(isnull(DisplayMode),"Unknown",tostring(DisplayMode))),
(ConfigLatest | project SessionKey,User,Host,Category="Graphics",Setting="Thinwire video codec type",Value=iff(isempty(ThinwireVideoCodecType),"Unknown",ThinwireVideoCodecType)),
(ConfigLatest | project SessionKey,User,Host,Category="Graphics",Setting="Thinwire video codec use",Value=iff(isempty(ThinwireVideoCodecUse),"Unknown",ThinwireVideoCodecUse)),
(ConfigLatest | project SessionKey,User,Host,Category="Graphics",Setting="Thinwire colorspace",Value=iff(isempty(ThinwireColorspace),"Unknown",ThinwireColorspace)),
(ConfigLatest | project SessionKey,User,Host,Category="Graphics",Setting="Hardware encoding in use",Value=iff(isnull(ThinwireHardwareEncodeInUse),"Unknown",tostring(ThinwireHardwareEncodeInUse))),
(ConfigLatest | project SessionKey,User,Host,Category="Graphics",Setting="Thinwire color depth",Value=iff(isnull(ThinwireColorDepth),"Unknown",tostring(ThinwireColorDepth))),
(ConfigLatest | project SessionKey,User,Host,Category="Graphics",Setting="Thinwire component encoder",Value=iff(isempty(ThinwireComponentEncoder),"Unknown",ThinwireComponentEncoder)),
(ConfigLatest | project SessionKey,User,Host,Category="Graphics",Setting="Policy FPS",Value=iff(isnull(ThinwirePolicyFps),"Unknown",tostring(ThinwirePolicyFps))),
(ConfigLatest | project SessionKey,User,Host,Category="Graphics",Setting="Policy hardware encoding",Value=iff(isnull(ThinwirePolicyUseHardwareEncoding),"Unknown",tostring(ThinwirePolicyUseHardwareEncoding))),
(ConfigLatest | project SessionKey,User,Host,Category="Graphics",Setting="Policy video codec",Value=iff(isempty(ThinwirePolicyUseVideoCodec),"Unknown",ThinwirePolicyUseVideoCodec)),
(ConfigLatest | project SessionKey,User,Host,Category="Graphics",Setting="Policy visual quality",Value=iff(isempty(ThinwirePolicyVisualQuality),"Unknown",ThinwirePolicyVisualQuality));
Settings
| where isempty(ConfigurationCategoryFilter) or ConfigurationCategoryFilter in ("All","Graphics")
| summarize Sessions=dcount(SessionKey),Users=dcountif(User,isnotempty(User)),Hosts=dcountif(Host,isnotempty(Host)) by Category,Setting,Value
| order by Setting asc,Sessions desc

let StartTime=_startTime;
let EndTime=_endTime;
let UserFilter=tolower(tostring(_user));
let HostFilter=tostring(_host);
let SessionFilter=tostring(_session);
let ProtocolFilter=tostring(_protocol);
let StateFilter=tostring(_connectionState);
let ConnectionPathFilter=tostring(_connectionPath);
let SeverityFilter=tostring(_severity);
let RttWarningMs=150;
let RttCriticalMs=300;
let RpLatencyWarningMs=100;
let RpLatencyCriticalMs=200;
let InputDelayWarningMs=100;
let InputDelayCriticalMs=200;
let FpsWarning=20;
let FpsCritical=10;
let ReconnectWarning=1;
let ReconnectCritical=3;
let EdtPacketWarning=1;
let EdtPacketCritical=10;
let Base=materialize(
    Session_SessionDetail
    | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | extend
        User=tolower(SessionUser),
        SessionKey=iff(
            isnotempty(tostring(SessionGUID)),
            tostring(SessionGUID),
            strcat(Host,"|",tostring(SessionID))
        )
    | extend ConnectionPath=case(
        tolower(tostring(SessionBrokerTunneledVmw)) in ("true","1","yes")
            or isnotempty(SessionBrokerTunnelUrlVmw),
        "Gateway/Tunneled",
        SessionClientIp startswith "10."
            or SessionClientIp startswith "192.168."
            or SessionClientIp matches regex "^172\\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[0-1])\\.",
        "Internal/Private",
        "External/Unknown"
    )
    | extend
        RTTMs=toreal(SessionRoundTripTimeMs),
        RPLatencyMs=toreal(SessionRpLatencyMs2),
        InputDelayMaxMs=toreal(SessionInputDelayMaxMs),
        InputDelayAvgMs=iff(
            toreal(SessionInputDelayCount)>0,
            toreal(SessionInputDelaySumMs)/toreal(SessionInputDelayCount),
            real(null)
        ),
        FPS=toreal(SessionFps),
        ReconnectCount=tolong(CtxAutoClientReconnectCount),
        EDTNAKPackets=tolong(CtxEDTNAKPacketsSent),
        OutOfOrderEDTPackets=tolong(CtxOutOfOrderEDTPackets)
    | where isempty(UserFilter) or User =~ UserFilter
    | where isempty(HostFilter) or Host =~ HostFilter
    | where isempty(SessionFilter) or SessionKey == SessionFilter
    | where isempty(ProtocolFilter) or SessionProtocol =~ ProtocolFilter
    | where isempty(StateFilter) or SessionConnectionState =~ StateFilter
    | where isempty(ConnectionPathFilter) or ConnectionPath =~ ConnectionPathFilter
    | project
        Timestamp,
        User,
        Host,
        SessionKey,
        SessionID,
        SessionGUID,
        Protocol=SessionProtocol,
        Transport=SessionTransportProtocols,
        ConnectionState=SessionConnectionState,
        ConnectionPath,
        ClientName=SessionClientName,
        ClientPlatform=SessionClientPlatform,
        ClientVersion=SessionClientVersion,
        RTTMs,
        RPLatencyMs,
        InputDelayMaxMs,
        InputDelayAvgMs,
        FPS,
        ReconnectCount,
        EDTNAKPackets,
        OutOfOrderEDTPackets
);
let PerSession=materialize(
    Base
    | summarize
        User=take_any(User),
        Host=take_any(Host),
        SessionID=take_any(SessionID),
        SessionGUID=take_any(SessionGUID),
        Protocol=take_any(Protocol),
        Transport=take_any(Transport),
        ConnectionState=take_any(ConnectionState),
        ConnectionPath=take_any(ConnectionPath),
        ClientName=take_any(ClientName),
        ClientPlatform=take_any(ClientPlatform),
        ClientVersion=take_any(ClientVersion),
        AvgRTTMs=round(avg(RTTMs),2),
        P95RTTMs=round(percentile(RTTMs,95),2),
        AvgRPLatencyMs=round(avg(RPLatencyMs),2),
        P95RPLatencyMs=round(percentile(RPLatencyMs,95),2),
        AvgInputDelayMs=round(avg(InputDelayAvgMs),2),
        P95InputDelayMaxMs=round(percentile(InputDelayMaxMs,95),2),
        AvgFPS=round(avg(FPS),2),
        P05FPS=round(percentile(FPS,5),2),
        ReconnectCount=max(ReconnectCount),
        EDTNAKPackets=max(EDTNAKPackets),
        OutOfOrderEDTPackets=max(OutOfOrderEDTPackets),
        FirstSeen=min(Timestamp),
        LastSeen=max(Timestamp)
        by SessionKey
    | extend
        RttPoints=case(
            isnull(P95RTTMs),0,
            P95RTTMs>=RttCriticalMs,2,
            P95RTTMs>=RttWarningMs,1,
            0
        ),
        RpPoints=case(
            isnull(P95RPLatencyMs),0,
            P95RPLatencyMs>=RpLatencyCriticalMs,2,
            P95RPLatencyMs>=RpLatencyWarningMs,1,
            0
        ),
        InputPoints=case(
            isnull(P95InputDelayMaxMs),0,
            P95InputDelayMaxMs>=InputDelayCriticalMs,2,
            P95InputDelayMaxMs>=InputDelayWarningMs,1,
            0
        ),
        FpsPoints=case(
            isnull(P05FPS),0,
            P05FPS<=FpsCritical,2,
            P05FPS<=FpsWarning,1,
            0
        ),
        ReconnectPoints=case(
            isnull(ReconnectCount),0,
            ReconnectCount>=ReconnectCritical,2,
            ReconnectCount>=ReconnectWarning,1,
            0
        ),
        EdtPoints=case(
            coalesce(EDTNAKPackets,0)+coalesce(OutOfOrderEDTPackets,0)>=EdtPacketCritical,2,
            coalesce(EDTNAKPackets,0)+coalesce(OutOfOrderEDTPackets,0)>=EdtPacketWarning,1,
            0
        )
    | extend
        PenaltyPoints=
            RttPoints+
            RpPoints+
            InputPoints+
            FpsPoints+
            ReconnectPoints+
            EdtPoints,
        CriticalIssueCount=
            iff(RttPoints==2,1,0)+
            iff(RpPoints==2,1,0)+
            iff(InputPoints==2,1,0)+
            iff(FpsPoints==2,1,0)+
            iff(ReconnectPoints==2,1,0)+
            iff(EdtPoints==2,1,0),
        WarningIssueCount=
            iff(RttPoints==1,1,0)+
            iff(RpPoints==1,1,0)+
            iff(InputPoints==1,1,0)+
            iff(FpsPoints==1,1,0)+
            iff(ReconnectPoints==1,1,0)+
            iff(EdtPoints==1,1,0),
        AvailableMetricCount=
            iff(isnotnull(P95RTTMs),1,0)+
            iff(isnotnull(P95RPLatencyMs),1,0)+
            iff(isnotnull(P95InputDelayMaxMs),1,0)+
            iff(isnotnull(P05FPS),1,0)+
            iff(isnotnull(ReconnectCount),1,0)+
            iff(
                isnotnull(EDTNAKPackets)
                    or isnotnull(OutOfOrderEDTPackets),
                1,
                0
            )
    | extend ExperienceScore=iff(
        AvailableMetricCount==0,
        real(null),
        round(
            100.0-
            (
                100.0*
                PenaltyPoints/
                (2.0*AvailableMetricCount)
            ),
            0
        )
    )
    | extend Severity=case(
        AvailableMetricCount==0,
        "Healthy",
        CriticalIssueCount>0 or ExperienceScore<60,
        "Critical",
        WarningIssueCount>0 or ExperienceScore<85,
        "Warning",
        "Healthy"
    )
);
PerSession
| extend PrimaryIssue=case(
    RttPoints==2,"Critical RTT",
    RpPoints==2,"Critical protocol latency",
    InputPoints==2,"Critical input delay",
    FpsPoints==2,"Critical FPS",
    ReconnectPoints==2,"Critical reconnects",
    EdtPoints==2,"Critical EDT quality",
    RttPoints==1,"High RTT",
    RpPoints==1,"High protocol latency",
    InputPoints==1,"High input delay",
    FpsPoints==1,"Low FPS",
    ReconnectPoints==1,"Reconnects",
    EdtPoints==1,"EDT quality",
    "No detected issue"
)
| where isempty(SeverityFilter) or Severity =~ SeverityFilter
| project
    Severity,
    ExperienceScore,
    PrimaryIssue,
    User,
    Host,
    SessionKey,
    SessionID,
    SessionGUID,
    Protocol,
    Transport,
    ConnectionState,
    ConnectionPath,
    ClientName,
    ClientPlatform,
    ClientVersion,
    AvgRTTMs,
    P95RTTMs,
    AvgRPLatencyMs,
    P95RPLatencyMs,
    AvgInputDelayMs,
    P95InputDelayMaxMs,
    AvgFPS,
    P05FPS,
    ReconnectCount,
    EDTNAKPackets,
    OutOfOrderEDTPackets,
    CriticalIssueCount,
    WarningIssueCount,
    AvailableMetricCount,
    FirstSeen,
    LastSeen
| order by Severity asc,ExperienceScore asc nulls last

let StartTime=_startTime;
let EndTime=_endTime;
let UserFilter=tolower(tostring(_user));
let HostFilter=tostring(_host);
let SessionFilter=tostring(_session);
let ProtocolFilter=tostring(_protocol);
let StateFilter=tostring(_connectionState);
let ConnectionPathFilter=tostring(_connectionPath);
let TimeBin=5m;
let Base=materialize(
    Session_SessionDetail
    | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | extend

        SessionKey=iff(
            isnotempty(tostring(SessionGUID)),
            tostring(SessionGUID),
            strcat(Host,"|",tostring(SessionID))
        )
    | where User !~ "sys"
    | extend ConnectionPath=case(
        tolower(tostring(SessionBrokerTunneledVmw)) in ("true","1","yes")
            or isnotempty(SessionBrokerTunnelUrlVmw),
        "Gateway/Tunneled",
        SessionClientIp startswith "10."
            or SessionClientIp startswith "192.168."
            or SessionClientIp matches regex "^172\\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[0-1])\\.",
        "Internal/Private",
        "External/Unknown"
    )
    | extend
        RTTMs=toreal(SessionRoundTripTimeMs),

        InputDelayAvgMs=iff(
            toreal(SessionInputDelayCount)>0,
            toreal(SessionInputDelaySumMs)/toreal(SessionInputDelayCount),
            real(null)
        ),
        FPS=toreal(SessionFps),
        ReconnectCount=tolong(CtxAutoClientReconnectCount),
        EDTNAKPackets=tolong(CtxEDTNAKPacketsSent),
        OutOfOrderEDTPackets=tolong(CtxOutOfOrderEDTPackets)
    | where isempty(UserFilter) or User =~ UserFilter
    | where isempty(HostFilter) or Host =~ HostFilter
    | where isempty(SessionFilter) or SessionKey == SessionFilter
    | where isempty(ProtocolFilter) or SessionProtocol =~ ProtocolFilter
    | where isempty(StateFilter) or SessionConnectionState =~ StateFilter
    | where isempty(ConnectionPathFilter) or ConnectionPath =~ ConnectionPathFilter
    | project
        Timestamp,
        User,
        Host,
        SessionKey,
        RTTMs,
        RPLatencyMs,
        InputDelayMaxMs,
        InputDelayAvgMs,
        FPS,
        ReconnectCount,
        EDTNAKPackets,
        OutOfOrderEDTPackets
);
Base
| where isnotempty(SessionFilter)
| summarize
    User=take_any(User),
    Host=take_any(Host),
    AvgRTTMs=round(avg(RTTMs),2),
    P95RTTMs=round(percentile(RTTMs,95),2),
    AvgRPLatencyMs=round(avg(RPLatencyMs),2),
    P95RPLatencyMs=round(percentile(RPLatencyMs,95),2),
    AvgInputDelayMs=round(avg(InputDelayAvgMs),2),
    P95InputDelayMaxMs=round(percentile(InputDelayMaxMs,95),2),
    AvgFPS=round(avg(FPS),2),
    P05FPS=round(percentile(FPS,5),2),
    ReconnectCount=max(ReconnectCount),
    EDTNAKPackets=max(EDTNAKPackets),
    OutOfOrderEDTPackets=max(OutOfOrderEDTPackets)
    by TimeBucket=bin(Timestamp,TimeBin),SessionKey
| order by TimeBucket asc

let StartTime=_startTime;
let EndTime=_endTime;
let UserFilter=tolower(tostring(_user));
let HostFilter=tostring(_host);
let SessionFilter=tostring(_session);
let HasSessionSelection=isnotempty(SessionFilter);
let SessionCandidates=materialize(
    Session_SessionDetail
    | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | extend
        User=tolower(SessionUser),
        SessionKey=iff(
            isnotempty(tostring(SessionGUID)),
            tostring(SessionGUID),
            strcat(Host,"|",tostring(SessionID))
        ),
        SessionGuidKey=tostring(SessionGUID)
    | where isempty(UserFilter) or User =~ UserFilter
    | where isempty(HostFilter) or Host =~ HostFilter
    | where isempty(SessionFilter) or SessionKey == SessionFilter
    | summarize arg_max(Timestamp,*) by SessionKey
);
let SessionLatest=materialize(
    SessionCandidates
    | sort by Timestamp desc
    | take 1
    | project
        SessionKey,
        SessionGuidKey,
        User,
        SessionHost=Host,
        SessionID,
        SessionGUID,
        SessionTimestamp=Timestamp,
        SessionConnectionState,
        SessionProtocol,
        SessionTransportProtocols,
        SessionClientName,
        SessionClientIp,
        SessionClientPlatform,
        SessionClientVersion,
        SessionPublishedName,
        SessionFgAppId,
        SessionFgProcessName,
        SessionFgWindowTitle,
        SessionCPUUsagePercent,
        SessionWorkingSetMB,
        SessionIOPS,
        SessionNetKBPS,
        SessionRoundTripTimeMs,
        SessionRpLatencyMs2,
        SessionInputDelayMaxMs,
        SessionFps
);
let ConfigLatest=
    CitrixSession_SessionConfig
    | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | extend SessionGuidKey=tostring(SessionGUID)
    | summarize arg_max(Timestamp,*) by SessionGuidKey
    | project
        SessionGuidKey,
        ConfigTimestamp=Timestamp,
        NetworkConnectedVia,
        NetworkEdtMtu,
        SessionReliabilityAllowed=NetworkPolicyAcceptSessionReliabilityConnections,
        DisplayMode,
        ThinwireVideoCodecType,
        ThinwireHardwareEncodeInUse,
        ThinwireColorDepth,
        AudioRedirection=AudioPolicyAllowRedirection,
        ClientDriveRedirection=CdmPolicyAllowDriveRedirection,
        PrinterRedirection=PrinterPolicyAllowRedirection,
        USBSupport=USBPolicyAllowUSBSupport;
let VirtualChannels=
    CitrixSession_VirtualChannelDetail
    | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | extend SessionGuidKey=tostring(SessionGUID)
    | summarize
        VirtualChannels=dcountif(
            VirtualChannelVendorName,
            isnotempty(VirtualChannelVendorName)
        ),
        VCInputMB=round(sum(VirtualChannelDataVolumeInputMB),2),
        VCOutputMB=round(sum(VirtualChannelDataVolumeOutputMB),2),
        VCLastSeen=max(Timestamp)
        by SessionGuidKey
    | extend VCTotalMB=round(VCInputMB+VCOutputMB,2);
let Detail=materialize(
    SessionLatest
    | join kind=leftouter ConfigLatest on SessionGuidKey
    | join kind=leftouter VirtualChannels on SessionGuidKey
    | extend DataStatus=iff(
        HasSessionSelection,
        "Selected session",
        "Latest matching session"
    )
    | project
        DataStatus,
        User,
        Host=SessionHost,
        SessionKey,
        SessionID,
        SessionGUID,
        SessionConnectionState,
        SessionProtocol,
        SessionTransportProtocols,
        SessionClientName,
        SessionClientIp,
        SessionClientPlatform,
        SessionClientVersion,
        SessionPublishedName,
        SessionFgAppId,
        SessionFgProcessName,
        SessionFgWindowTitle,
        SessionCPUUsagePercent=round(SessionCPUUsagePercent,2),
        SessionWorkingSetMB=round(SessionWorkingSetMB,2),
        SessionIOPS=round(SessionIOPS,2),
        SessionNetKBPS=round(SessionNetKBPS,2),
        SessionRoundTripTimeMs,
        SessionRpLatencyMs2=round(SessionRpLatencyMs2,2),
        SessionInputDelayMaxMs,
        SessionFps,
        NetworkConnectedVia,
        NetworkEdtMtu,
        SessionReliabilityAllowed,
        DisplayMode,
        ThinwireVideoCodecType,
        ThinwireHardwareEncodeInUse,
        ThinwireColorDepth,
        AudioRedirection,
        ClientDriveRedirection,
        PrinterRedirection,
        USBSupport,
        VirtualChannels,
        VCInputMB,
        VCOutputMB,
        VCTotalMB,
        SessionTimestamp,
        ConfigTimestamp,
        VCLastSeen
);
let DetailRows=toscalar(Detail | count);
union
    Detail,
    (
        print
            DataStatus=iff(
                HasSessionSelection,
                "No matching session in the selected time range",
                "No session matches the selected user, host, and time range"
            ),
            User=UserFilter,
            Host=HostFilter,
            SessionKey=SessionFilter
        | where DetailRows == 0
    )

let StartTime=_startTime;
let EndTime=_endTime;
let UserFilter=tostring(_user);
let HostFilter=tostring(_host);
let SessionFilter=tostring(_session);
let HasSessionSelection=isnotempty(SessionFilter);
let SessionMap=materialize(
    Session_SessionDetail
    | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | extend
        User=tolower(SessionUser),
        SessionKey=iff(
            isnotempty(tostring(SessionGUID)),
            tostring(SessionGUID),
            strcat(Host,"|",tostring(SessionID))
        )
    | where HasSessionSelection
    | where isempty(UserFilter) or User =~ UserFilter
    | where isempty(HostFilter) or Host =~ HostFilter
    | where SessionKey == SessionFilter
    | summarize arg_max(Timestamp,User,Host,SessionID) by SessionKey
    | project SessionKey,User,Host,SessionID
);
let ProcessSummary=materialize(
    Process_ProcessDetail
    | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | join kind=inner SessionMap on Host,SessionID
    | summarize
        Processes=dcount(ProcGUID),
        ProcessSamples=count(),
        AvgCPUPercent=round(avg(ProcCPUPercent),2),
        PeakCPUPercent=round(max(ProcCPUPercent),2),
        AvgWorkingSetMB=round(avg(ProcWorkingSetMB),2),
        PeakWorkingSetMB=round(max(ProcWorkingSetMB),2),
        AvgIOPS=round(avg(ProcIOPSRead+ProcIOPSWrite),2),
        PeakIOPS=round(max(ProcIOPSRead+ProcIOPSWrite),2),
        AvgNetworkKBPS=round(avg(ProcNetKBPS),2),
        PeakNetworkKBPS=round(max(ProcNetKBPS),2),
        FirstSeen=min(Timestamp),
        LastSeen=max(Timestamp)
        by SessionKey,User,Host,SessionID
    | extend DataStatus="Data available"
    | project
        DataStatus,
        SessionKey,
        User,
        Host,
        SessionID,
        Processes,
        ProcessSamples,
        AvgCPUPercent,
        PeakCPUPercent,
        AvgWorkingSetMB,
        PeakWorkingSetMB,
        AvgIOPS,
        PeakIOPS,
        AvgNetworkKBPS,
        PeakNetworkKBPS,
        FirstSeen,
        LastSeen
);
let SummaryRows=toscalar(ProcessSummary | count);
union
    ProcessSummary,
    (
        print
            DataStatus=iff(
                HasSessionSelection,
                "No process data for the selected session and time range",
                "Select a session to view process summary"
            ),
            SessionKey=SessionFilter,
            User=UserFilter,
            Host=HostFilter,
            SessionID=long(null),
            Processes=long(0),
            ProcessSamples=long(0),
            AvgCPUPercent=real(0),
            PeakCPUPercent=real(0),

let StartTime=_startTime;

let UserFilter=tolower(tostring(_user));

let SessionMap=materialize(
    Session_SessionDetail
    | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | extend
        User=tolower(SessionUser),
        SessionKey=iff(
            isnotempty(tostring(SessionGUID)),
            tostring(SessionGUID),
            strcat(Host,"|",tostring(SessionID))
        )
    | where User !~ "sys"
    | where isempty(UserFilter) or User =~ UserFilter
    | where isempty(HostFilter) or Host =~ HostFilter
    | where isempty(SessionFilter) or SessionKey == SessionFilter
    | summarize arg_max(Timestamp,User,Host,SessionID) by SessionKey
    | sort by Timestamp desc
    | take 1
    | project SessionKey,User,Host,SessionID
);
let AppMapping=
    Application_AppNameIdMapping
    | where Timestamp between (StartTime-7d .. EndTime)
    | summarize arg_max(Timestamp,AppName) by Host,AppId
    | project Host,AppId,AppName;
let ApplicationRows=materialize(
    Process_ProcessDetail
    | where Timestamp between (StartTime .. EndTime)
    | join kind=inner SessionMap on Host,SessionID
    | join kind=leftouter AppMapping on Host,AppId
    | extend
        Application=coalesce(AppName,AppId,ProcName,"Unknown"),
        ProcessName=ProcName
    | summarize
        Processes=dcount(ProcGUID),
        ProcessSamples=count(),
        AvgCPUPercent=round(avg(ProcCPUPercent),2),
        PeakCPUPercent=round(max(ProcCPUPercent),2),
        AvgWorkingSetMB=round(avg(ProcWorkingSetMB),2),
        PeakWorkingSetMB=round(max(ProcWorkingSetMB),2),
        AvgIOPS=round(avg(ProcIOPSRead+ProcIOPSWrite),2),

        AvgNetworkKBPS=round(avg(ProcNetKBPS),2),
        PeakNetworkKBPS=round(max(ProcNetKBPS),2),
        FirstSeen=min(Timestamp),
        LastSeen=max(Timestamp)
        by
            User,
            Host,
            SessionKey,
            SessionID,
            Application,
            ProcessName,
            AppVersion
    | extend DataStatus="Data available"
    | project
        DataStatus,
        User,
        Host,
        SessionKey,
        SessionID,
        Application,
        ProcessName,
        AppVersion,
        Processes,
        ProcessSamples,
        AvgCPUPercent,
        PeakCPUPercent,
        AvgWorkingSetMB,
        PeakWorkingSetMB,
        AvgIOPS,
        PeakIOPS,
        AvgNetworkKBPS,
        PeakNetworkKBPS,
        FirstSeen,
        LastSeen
);
let ApplicationRowCount=toscalar(ApplicationRows | count);

            ),
            User=UserFilter,
            Host=HostFilter,
            SessionKey=SessionFilter,
            Application="",
            ProcessName=""
        | where ApplicationRowCount == 0
    )
